g.text: Footprints, the ES8311 QFN-20 land pattern and the acoustic assembly are still not released.

g.desc: Footprints, the ES8311 QFN-20 land pattern and the acoustic assembly are still not released.

g.text: ES8311 typical circuit separates GND(SYS) from AGND with 0 ohm; one GND net is kept until the PCB ground-strategy decision is taken.

g.desc: ES8311 typical circuit separates GND(SYS) from AGND with 0 ohm; one GND net is kept until the PCB ground-strategy decision is taken.

g.text: Filterless BTL: never reference SPK_P or SPK_N to ground, keep the pair short, and add the datasheet ferrite-bead filter when the runs exceed 20 cm.

g.desc: Filterless BTL: never reference SPK_P or SPK_N to ground, keep the pair short, and add the datasheet ferrite-bead filter when the runs exceed 20 cm.

g.text: SHDN releases through R601/C614 for a datasheet 1-100 ms delay after VBAT rises; no spare GPIO exists for explicit enable control.

g.desc: SHDN releases through R601/C614 for a datasheet 1-100 ms delay after VBAT rises; no spare GPIO exists for explicit enable control.

g.text: Codec I2C address is 0011 00x, CE strapped low gives 0x18; no clash with BMI270 0x68, RV-3028-C7 0x51/0x52, MAX17048 0x36 or DRV2605L 0x5A.

g.desc: Codec I2C address is 0011 00x, CE strapped low gives 0x18; no clash with BMI270 0x68, RV-3028-C7 0x51/0x52, MAX17048 0x36 or DRV2605L 0x5A.

g.text: ES8311 Rev 5.0 documents no mic bias or electret supply pin; the MIC1N reference and the mic bias network stay TBD with the microphone selection.

g.desc: ES8311 Rev 5.0 documents no mic bias or electret supply pin; the MIC1N reference and the mic bias network stay TBD with the microphone selection.

g.text: One 220 nF cap per side merges the ES8311 output coupling with the PAM8302A CI 0.1-0.22 uF requirement; corner against the internal 10 k is about 72 Hz.

g.desc: One 220 nF cap per side merges the ES8311 output coupling with the PAM8302A CI 0.1-0.22 uF requirement; corner against the internal 10 k is about 72 Hz.

g.text: Amp VDD drafted on VBAT (2.0-5.5 V allowed, SHDN must stay within VDD+0.3 V); +3V3_SYS and SYS stay open options - confirm cell impedance and peak current with the pack data.

g.desc: Amp VDD drafted on VBAT (2.0-5.5 V allowed, SHDN must stay within VDD+0.3 V); +3V3_SYS and SYS stay open options - confirm cell impedance and peak current with the pack data.

g.text: PAM8302A delivers 0.72 W min / 0.80 W typ into 8 ohm at VDD=3.6 V and 10% THD+N; 1 W from a 3.3 V rail is not achievable. A 1 W speaker rating is not delivered power.

g.desc: PAM8302A delivers 0.72 W min / 0.80 W typ into 8 ohm at VDD=3.6 V and 10% THD+N; 1 W from a 3.3 V rail is not achievable. A 1 W speaker rating is not delivered power.

g.text: ES8311 in slave mode expects externally supplied SCLK/LRCK; in master mode both derive from MCLK. Clock direction and ESP32 I2S feasibility remain unvalidated.

g.desc: ES8311 in slave mode expects externally supplied SCLK/LRCK; in master mode both derive from MCLK. Clock direction and ESP32 I2S feasibility remain unvalidated.

g.text: ES8311 Rev 5.0 recommended supply: DVDD/PVDD 1.6-3.6 V, AVDD 1.7-3.6 V, absolute max 3.6 V; hold +3V3_SYS inside 3.0-3.6 V or the codec keeps no headroom.

g.desc: ES8311 Rev 5.0 recommended supply: DVDD/PVDD 1.6-3.6 V, AVDD 1.7-3.6 V, absolute max 3.6 V; hold +3V3_SYS inside 3.0-3.6 V or the codec keeps no headroom.

g.text: TBD / NO PHYSICAL PIN NUMBERS / NO FOOTPRINT

g.desc: TBD / NO PHYSICAL PIN NUMBERS / NO FOOTPRINT

g.text: TBD / NO PHYSICAL PIN NUMBERS / NO FOOTPRINT

g.desc: TBD / NO PHYSICAL PIN NUMBERS / NO FOOTPRINT

g.text: PAM8302A gain is fixed by the internal 150k/10k pair at 23.5 dB. The ES8311 full-scale output is 0.4535 Vrms, so the amp clips before full codec volume; trim with the DAC volume register or add an external RIN of about 16k ohm once the acoustic target is set.

g.desc: PAM8302A gain is fixed by the internal 150k/10k pair at 23.5 dB. The ES8311 full-scale output is 0.4535 Vrms, so the amp clips before full codec volume; trim with the DAC volume register or add an external RIN of about 16k ohm once the acoustic target is set.

g.text: ES8311 Rev 5.0 package drawing shows an unnumbered exposed die-attach pad and the typical circuit labels that pad 21/PGND, while the pin table lists only 1-20; U9 keeps 20 pins until the vendor release confirms the pad and its net.

g.desc: ES8311 Rev 5.0 package drawing shows an unnumbered exposed die-attach pad and the typical circuit labels that pad 21/PGND, while the pin table lists only 1-20; U9 keeps 20 pins until the vendor release confirms the pad and its net.
